verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy axis for an agent SDK, which stores session memory and uploads traces. However, the pack documents no retention periods, deletion APIs, or ways to purge session or trace data. The only related evidence is a global switch to disable tracing, which is an adjacent collection toggle rather than a retention or deletion control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
